newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end below highs after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end below highs after U.S. data.

text.p: 1615 GMT - Portuguese shares ended below the day's highs after easing back on U.S. NAPM and payrolls data which raised new inflationary fears and concern over a possible U.S. rate rise. Liquidity in the cash market was 19.4 billion escudos. Dealers said the trend on Monday would depend on the extent of the fall of Wall Street today. "The local market reacted negatively to the drop on foreign markets, and the indices at one time were falling, but at the end we saw some buying that pushed the indices up half a percentage point," a dealer said. In today's session the following companies hit new highs: BCP, BPSM, Cimpor, Portucel, Inparsa, Sonae Industria. Mundial Confianca and BPSM reacted positively to their first-half results.

* Utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal fell in anticipation of the impact of the entry to the market of a further 60 million EDP shares held by small investors, employees and emigrants on September 17. EDP closed at 3,086 escudos, down 65, in volume of 1,090,630 shares. Dealers said the share could fall towards 3,000 escudos on Monday.
